title: Altretamine
overview: Altretamine may cause severe nerve damage. If you experience any of the following symptoms, call your doctor immediately: pain, burning, numbness, or tingling in the hands or feet; weakness in the arms or legs; or loss of ability to move your arms or legs; changes in mood; or loss of consciousness.

sections.Before taking altretamine,: tell your doctor and pharmacist if you are allergic to altretamine, any other medications, or any of the ingredients in altretamine capsules. Ask your pharmacist for a list of the ingredients.Tell your doctor and pharmacist what prescription and nonprescription medications, vitamins, nutritional supplements, and herbal products you are taking or plan to take while taking altretamine. Your doctor may need to change the doses of your medications or monitor you carefully for side effects..The following nonprescription products may interact with altretamine: cimetidine (Tagamet). Be sure to let your doctor and pharmacist know that you are taking these medications before you start taking altretamine. Do not start any of these medications while taking altretamine without discussing with your healthcare provider.tell your doctor if you have nervous system disorders or blood disorders. Your doctor may tell you not to take altretamine.tell your doctor if you are pregnant, plan to become pregnant, or are breast-feeding. You should not become pregnant or breast-feed while you are taking altretamine. If you become pregnant while taking altretamine, call your doctor. Altretamine may harm the fetus.
sections.Altretamine may cause side effects. Tell: nauseavomitingloss of appetiteunusual tiredness or weaknessdizzinesspale skinfaintingskin rashitchinghair loss
sections.Some side effects can be serious. If you: fever, chills, sore throat, ongoing cough and congestion, or other signs of an infectionunusual bleeding or bruisingbloody or black, tarry stoolsbloody vomitvomited material that looks like coffee groundsbleeding gumssmall, round, red or purple colored spots on the skinAltretamine may cause other side effects. Call your doctor if you have any unusual problems while taking this medication.If you experience a serious side effect, you or your doctor may send a report to the Food and Drug Administration's (FDA) MedWatch Adverse Event Reporting program online (https://www.fda.gov/Safety/MedWatch) or by phone (1-800-332-1088).
